full_prompt_en: A square early-Renaissance-inspired tempera illustration shows a young figure in left-facing profile wearing an elaborate headdress of layered green, gold, and red feathers. The face is pale and finely modeled, with downcast eyes, a straight nose, and a calm closed mouth. Below the cheek, a small golden bird looks upward, partly nestled against the richly patterned shoulder. A deep crimson and gold garment wraps the neck and chest, with fine embroidered bands following the folds. Every surrounding inch is filled with gilded architectural relief, coiling vines, tiny flowers, and ornamental panels. The background is shallow and decorative rather than an open landscape. Precise dark outlines contain the feather rows, bird plumage, jewelry, and carved patterns. Gold and ochre glow against teal green, brick red, cream, and warm brown. Illumination is even, with small highlights on the face and feather tips and soft brown shadow beneath the chin. The quiet expression offers a visual rest amid the dense ornament. Layered forms overlap but remain almost flattened into a precious patterned surface. The frame is close, cutting the headdress at the top and garment at the bottom. The overall image feels ceremonial, intricate, and jewel-like, with human stillness held inside a richly crafted world.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形早期文艺复兴气息的蛋彩插画描绘一位朝左侧面的年轻人，戴着绿、金、红羽毛层层构成的繁复头饰。脸浅而细致塑形，眼睛低垂，鼻直，嘴平静闭合。面颊下方一只金色小鸟仰头，半藏在花纹繁密的肩旁。深红金色衣服裹住颈胸，细刺绣带顺褶皱展开。四周几乎每寸都填着镀金建筑浮雕、卷蔓、小花与装饰板。背景浅而装饰性强，不是开阔景观。准确深色轮廓圈住羽排、鸟羽、首饰和雕刻纹。金与赭在青绿、砖红、奶油和暖棕前发亮。照明均匀，脸与羽尖有小高光，颌下有柔棕影。安静表情在浓密纹饰间提供视觉休息。层叠形体虽互相覆盖，整体仍几乎压平为珍贵花纹表面。构图贴近，顶部截去头饰，下部截去衣物。整幅礼仪化、繁密且宝石般，人静止于精心制作的世界中。
style_prompt_en: Tempera-like decorative painting uses precise contours, gilded relief detail, and tightly controlled jewel color. Gold and ochre mingle with teal, brick red, cream, and warm brown. Repeated feather-like and vegetal motifs fill a shallow patterned field, while a smoother pale focal plane gives the eye rest. Even light sets small highlights on raised ornament without deep theatrical shadow. Overlapping layers create richness more than realistic distance. Every edge feels carefully drawn and materially precious. The composition is ceremonial, intricate, and still.
style_prompt_zh: 蛋彩般装饰绘画运用准确轮廓、镀金浮雕细节与严格控制的宝石色。金和赭与青绿、砖红、奶油及暖棕交融。重复羽状和植物纹样填满浅层花纹底域，较平滑浅色焦点平面让视线休息。均匀光在凸起饰物上留下小高光，没有深戏剧影。覆盖层次创造丰富感，胜过写实距离。每处边缘都精心绘出，材料感珍贵。构图礼仪化、繁密且静止。
theme_en: A young figure in an elaborate feathered headdress beside a small bird
theme_zh: 戴繁复羽饰的年轻人身旁有只小鸟
name: Carlo Crivelli
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
